description: 0.1.3 is released and its manifest exists, but the image cannot be pulled on the runner. That is recorded as a result of its own (could not be tested), so the row names the cause every week instead of reading 'the leg did not report; re-run the sweep' forever.

issue_contains: Gateway `0.1.3`, above the range: an image could not be pulled. Link: **none tested: no request reached the gateway**.
Not a compatibility result: an image could not be pulled, so no gateway was started, so neither link was tested. The `Pull images` step names the image.
